title: Unary paired length encoding
statement: Let $\ell_1,\ell_2 : \{0,1\}^* \to \mathbb{N}$ be functions, and let $y$ be a finite bit string. The encoding of $y$ is the pair encoding of the unary strings of lengths $\ell_1(y)$ and $\ell_2(y)$, respectively.
